title: Puzzle2d Node Kind Vortices From Kit
description: Puzzle2d Node Kind Vortices From Kit
summary: Node kinds in puzzle 2d now support `vortices` templates (`vortexKind`, `angle`, `radius`) on `meta.kindCatalogs.nodes`, with parsing/serialization helpers (`puzzle2dRectangleHandleAngleFromCadPoint`, `puzzle2dFixtureHandlesFromNodeKindVortices`). Baked 45/50 nakagin node kinds from metabolism kit type connectors into `nakagin-capsule-tower.2d.json` (one-off migration, script removed). Vitest 106/106 pass for @puzzle/2d/react.
